items.title: Sponsored product ad
clues: I look like part of the shelf.
I appear in search results or on product pages.
A brand pays for me to rank higher.
I am usually marked as an ad.
items.why: Sponsored product ads promote a listing inside the retailer’s own pages.

items.title: Closed-loop measurement
clues: I link seeing an ad to buying.
Retailers can do this because they see the sale.
I answer: did the ad lead to a purchase?
items.why: Closed-loop measurement ties ad exposure to purchases.

items.title: Retail media network
clues: I am run by a seller of products.
I sell ad space on that seller’s channels.
Brands buy me to reach shoppers near the moment of purchase.
My owner has lots of shopper data.
items.why: A retail media network is a retailer’s advertising business.
